dashboards.description: Market-level supply, host growth, review volume, room mix, and sentiment for the Airbnb Berlin market.

cards.name: KPI - Total Listings
cards.description: Count of listings in the 2021-11-19 Airbnb Berlin snapshot. One row per listing; use this as the denominator for listing-level shares.
cards.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_listings
FROM analytics.dim_listings;

cards.name: KPI - Total Hosts
cards.description: Count of host profiles in the snapshot. One row per host; hosts with no listings are retained.
cards.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_hosts
FROM analytics.dim_hosts;

cards.name: KPI - Total Reviews
cards.description: Count of distinct reviews in the review fact. One row per review; duplicate reviews are removed upstream.
cards.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_reviews
FROM analytics.fct_reviews;

cards.name: KPI - Active Listings (12m)
cards.description: Listings with at least one review in the trailing 12 months ending 2021-11-19. One row per listing; this is not a review count.

cards.name: KPI - Avg Nightly Price
cards.description: Average source nightly price across listings, excluding zero-price and p99.5 outliers. One row per listing; the source currency is not normalized.

cards.name: Chart - Supply and Host Growth
cards.description: Monthly cumulative listing and host counts from the dbt month spine. One row per month; values are cumulative, not new additions.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    month_start,
    'Cumulative listings' AS metric,
    cumulative_listings::numeric AS value
FROM analytics.mart_executive_kpis
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{month_start}}

UNION ALL

SELECT
    month_start,
    'Cumulative hosts' AS metric,
    cumulative_hosts::numeric AS value
FROM analytics.mart_executive_kpis
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{month_start}}

ORDER BY month_start, metric;

cards.name: Chart - New Listings per Month
cards.description: Listings created in each month, through 2021-10 to exclude the partial snapshot month. One row per month.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    month_start,
    new_listings
FROM analytics.mart_executive_kpis
WHERE month_start <= DATE '2021-10-01'
  AND {{month_start}}
ORDER BY month_start;

cards.name: Chart - Monthly Reviews
cards.description: Reviews submitted per month through 2021-10. One row per month; early months have few or zero reviews.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    month_start,
    reviews
FROM analytics.mart_executive_kpis
WHERE month_start <= DATE '2021-10-01'
  AND {{month_start}}
ORDER BY month_start;

cards.name: Chart - Room Type Mix
cards.description: Listings by standardized room type in the current snapshot. One row per room type.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    room_type,
    COUNT(*) AS listings
FROM analytics.dim_listings
GROUP BY room_type
ORDER BY listings DESC;

cards.name: Chart - Sentiment Mix
cards.description: Reviews by source sentiment category. One row per review; unknown means the source did not provide a sentiment.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    review_sentiment,
    COUNT(*) AS reviews
FROM analytics.fct_reviews
GROUP BY review_sentiment
ORDER BY reviews DESC;

cards.name: Chart - Avg Sentiment Trend
cards.description: Monthly mean sentiment score (positive=1, neutral=0, negative=-1) through 2021-10. One row per month; unknown reviews are excluded from the mean.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    month_start,
    avg_sentiment
FROM analytics.mart_executive_kpis
WHERE month_start <= DATE '2021-10-01'
  AND {{month_start}}
ORDER BY month_start;

cards.name: Chart - Superhost Share Trend
cards.description: Share of cumulative listings whose host is a superhost, by month through 2021-10. One row per month.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    month_start,
    superhost_share
FROM analytics.mart_executive_kpis
WHERE month_start <= DATE '2021-10-01'
  AND {{month_start}}
ORDER BY month_start;

cards.name: Chart - Review Volume by Room Type
cards.description: Monthly reviews by listing room type through 2021-10. One row per month and room type; each review belongs to one room type.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    month_start,
    room_type,
    reviews
FROM analytics.mart_market_monthly
WHERE month_start <= DATE '2021-10-01'
  AND {{month_start}}
ORDER BY month_start, room_type;

cards.name: Chart - Listing Age Cohorts
cards.description: Listings by age cohort as of 2021-11-19. One row per listing; cohorts are derived from listing creation date.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    listing_age_cohort,
    COUNT(*) AS listings
FROM analytics.dim_listings
GROUP BY listing_age_cohort
ORDER BY listings DESC;

dashboards.description: Price distribution, room-type benchmarks, minimum-night segments, and superhost pricing comparisons.

cards.name: KPI - Total Listings
cards.description: Count of listings matching the selected Supply filters. One row per listing; use this as the denominator for supply shares on this dashboard.

cards.name: KPI - Median Nightly Price
cards.description: Median source nightly price across non-outlier listings. One row per listing; robust to extreme prices. Fixed card, not filtered by the dashboard.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) AS median_price
FROM analytics.dim_listings
WHERE NOT is_price_outlier;

cards.name: KPI - Avg Nightly Price (excl. outliers)
cards.description: Mean source nightly price across non-outlier listings matching the selected filters. One row per listing; sensitive to high prices.

cards.name: KPI - Outlier Listings
cards.description: Listings flagged as zero-price or above the p99.5 price for their room type. One row per listing; outliers stay in the data and are excluded from price averages.

cards.name: KPI - Superhost Listings
cards.description: Listings whose host is a superhost. One row per listing; 15 hosts have unknown superhost status and are excluded from the true-filter count.

cards.name: Chart - Listings by Price Band
cards.description: Listings by derived price band, in band order. One row per listing; the chart collapses to one bar when the Price band filter is applied.

cards.name: Chart - Price Band by Room Type
cards.description: Listings by price band and room type. One row per price band and room type; the spine is zero-filled, so all 28 combinations exist.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    price_band,
    room_type,
    SUM(listing_count) AS listings
FROM analytics.mart_price_bands
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{room_type}}
  AND {{price_band}}
GROUP BY price_band, room_type
ORDER BY CASE price_band
    WHEN '<30' THEN 1
    WHEN '30-49' THEN 2
    WHEN '50-74' THEN 3
    WHEN '75-99' THEN 4
    WHEN '100-149' THEN 5
    WHEN '150-249' THEN 6
    ELSE 7
END, room_type;

cards.name: Chart - Room Type Price Benchmark
cards.description: Median and p90 source nightly price by room type, excluding outliers. One row per room type; p90 shows the high-price tail.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    room_type,
    'Median price' AS metric,
    median_price::numeric AS value
FROM analytics.mart_room_type_benchmark
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{room_type}}

UNION ALL

SELECT
    room_type,
    'P90 price' AS metric,
    p90_price::numeric AS value
FROM analytics.mart_room_type_benchmark
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{room_type}}

ORDER BY room_type, metric;

cards.name: Chart - Supply Share by Room Type
cards.description: Share of the 17,499-listing snapshot by room type. One row per room type; shares sum to 100%.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    room_type,
    listing_count
FROM analytics.mart_room_type_benchmark
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{room_type}}
ORDER BY listing_count DESC;

cards.name: Chart - Minimum Nights Distribution
cards.description: Listings by minimum-night band. One row per listing; zero minimum nights are normalized to one upstream.

cards.name: Chart - Active Share by Price Band
cards.description: Unweighted average of room-type active shares within each price band. One row per price band; active means a review in the trailing 12 months.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    price_band,
    AVG(pct_active) AS active_share
FROM analytics.mart_price_bands
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{room_type}}
  AND {{price_band}}
GROUP BY price_band
ORDER BY CASE price_band
    WHEN '<30' THEN 1
    WHEN '30-49' THEN 2
    WHEN '50-74' THEN 3
    WHEN '75-99' THEN 4
    WHEN '100-149' THEN 5
    WHEN '150-249' THEN 6
    ELSE 7
END;

cards.name: Chart - Superhost Share by Price Band
cards.description: Unweighted average of room-type superhost shares within each price band. One row per price band; not a listing-weighted share.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    price_band,
    AVG(pct_superhost) AS superhost_share
FROM analytics.mart_price_bands
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{room_type}}
  AND {{price_band}}
GROUP BY price_band
ORDER BY CASE price_band
    WHEN '<30' THEN 1
    WHEN '30-49' THEN 2
    WHEN '50-74' THEN 3
    WHEN '75-99' THEN 4
    WHEN '100-149' THEN 5
    WHEN '150-249' THEN 6
    ELSE 7
END;

cards.name: Table - Room Type Benchmark
cards.description: One row per room type with supply share, price distribution, review volume, sentiment, superhost share, and active share.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    room_type,
    listing_count,
    share_of_supply,
    avg_price,
    median_price,
    p90_price,
    avg_reviews,
    median_reviews,
    avg_sentiment,
    pct_superhost,
    pct_active
FROM analytics.mart_room_type_benchmark
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{room_type}}
ORDER BY listing_count DESC;

dashboards.description: Review volume and seasonality, sentiment, and keyword topic mentions across guest comments.

cards.name: KPI - Total Reviews
cards.description: Count of distinct reviews matching the selected Guest filters. One row per review; duplicate reviews are removed upstream.

cards.name: KPI - Positive Review Share
cards.description: Positive reviews divided by all reviews. One row per review; the denominator includes neutral, negative, and unknown sentiment. Fixed card.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_sentiment = 'positive')::numeric
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS positive_share
FROM analytics.fct_reviews;

cards.name: KPI - Negative Review Share
cards.description: Negative reviews divided by all reviews. One row per review; the denominator includes positive, neutral, and unknown sentiment. Fixed card.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_sentiment = 'negative')::numeric
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS negative_share
FROM analytics.fct_reviews;

cards.name: KPI - Avg Sentiment Score
cards.description: Mean sentiment score (positive=1, neutral=0, negative=-1) for the filtered reviews. One row per review; unknown reviews are excluded.

cards.name: KPI - Reviews in 2021
cards.description: Reviews submitted in calendar year 2021 matching the selected filters. One row per review.

cards.name: Chart - Review Volume by Month
cards.description: Reviews submitted per month through 2021-10. One row per month; 2021-11 is excluded because review data ends in October.

cards.name: Chart - Sentiment Mix
cards.description: Reviews by source sentiment category. One row per review; unknown means no source sentiment.

cards.name: Chart - Sentiment by Month
cards.description: Reviews by month and sentiment category through 2021-10. One row per month and sentiment.

cards.name: Chart - Reviews by Room Type
cards.description: Reviews grouped by the room type of the reviewed listing. One row per review; each review belongs to one listing and one room type.

cards.name: Chart - Review Length
cards.description: Distribution of comment length in characters for reviews with comments. One row per review; reviews without comments are excluded.

cards.name: Chart - Topic Mentions
cards.description: Keyword-topic mentions across review comments. One row per month and topic in the source; totals exceed the review count because one review can mention multiple topics.

cards.name: Chart - Topic Mention Rate Trend
cards.description: Average monthly share of comment-bearing reviews that mention each topic, for the last 24 complete months. One row per month and topic; unweighted average of monthly rates.

cards.name: Chart - Negative Mentions by Topic
cards.description: Average share of topic mentions with negative sentiment, by topic. One row per month and topic rolled up; unweighted average across months.

cards.name: Table - Topic Detail
cards.description: Monthly topic mentions, mention rate, average sentiment, and negative share for the last 12 complete months. One row per month and topic.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    month_start,
    topic,
    mentions,
    mention_rate,
    avg_sentiment,
    pct_negative
FROM analytics.mart_review_topics
WHERE month_start BETWEEN DATE '2020-11-01' AND DATE '2021-10-01'
  AND {{review_month}}
  AND {{topic}}
ORDER BY mentions DESC
LIMIT 1000;

dashboards.description: Portfolio concentration, professional host segments, and superhost performance.

cards.name: KPI - Total Hosts
cards.description: Count of host profiles matching the selected Host filters. One row per host; hosts with no listings are retained.

cards.name: KPI - Superhosts
cards.description: Hosts whose superhost flag is true. One row per host; 15 hosts with unknown status are excluded.

cards.name: KPI - Single-listing Hosts
cards.description: Hosts with exactly one listing in the snapshot. One row per host; this is a host count, not a listing count.

cards.name: KPI - Professional+ Hosts
cards.description: Hosts in the Professional, Large professional, or Enterprise segments. One row per host; segments are based on listing count.

cards.name: KPI - Avg Reviews per Host
cards.description: Mean total reviews per host across all of the host's listings. One row per host; not a per-listing average.

cards.name: Chart - Hosts by Segment
cards.description: Hosts by portfolio segment. One row per host; these are host-grain counts and will not match listing-grain segment counts.

cards.name: Chart - Avg Listings per Host by Segment
cards.description: Mean number of listings per host within each segment. One row per host; host-grain calculation.

cards.name: Chart - Avg Reviews per Host by Segment
cards.description: Mean total reviews per host within each segment. One row per host; host-grain calculation.

cards.name: Chart - New Hosts per Month
cards.description: Host profiles created per month from 2015 onward. One row per host; this is new hosts, not cumulative hosts.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', host_created_at)::date AS month_start,
    COUNT(*) AS new_hosts
FROM analytics.dim_hosts
WHERE host_created_at >= DATE '2015-01-01'
  AND {{host_created_at}}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

cards.name: Chart - Superhost Performance
cards.description: Average total reviews per host for superhosts vs non-superhosts. One row per host; includes an unclassified group for 15 hosts with unknown status.

cards.name: Chart - Hosts by Segment and Superhost
cards.description: Host counts by segment and superhost status. One row per host; the stacked bars sum to the host total.

cards.name: Chart - Portfolio Size
cards.description: Distribution of hosts by number of listings. One row per host; most hosts have one listing and the maximum is 75.

cards.name: Table - Top Hosts
cards.description: Top 100 hosts by total reviews with portfolio size, active listings, and sentiment. One row per host.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    host_name,
    host_segment,
    is_superhost,
    listing_count,
    active_listing_count,
    total_reviews,
    avg_reviews_per_listing,
    avg_sentiment
FROM analytics.mart_host_performance
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{host_segment}}
  AND {{is_superhost}}
  AND {{listing_count}}
ORDER BY total_reviews DESC
LIMIT 100;

dashboards.description: One-row-per-listing drill-down for price, activity, review volume, and sentiment.

cards.name: KPI - Listings in View
cards.description: Count of listings matching the selected Listing Explorer filters. One row per listing; responds to every dashboard filter and is the denominator for listing-level shares.

cards.name: KPI - Avg Price in View
cards.description: Mean source nightly price of filtered listings, excluding outliers. One row per listing; currency is not normalized.

cards.name: KPI - Avg Reviews in View
cards.description: Mean lifetime review count per filtered listing. One row per listing; this is not a monthly review rate.

cards.name: KPI - Active Listings in View
cards.description: Filtered listings with at least one review in the trailing 12 months. One row per listing; the Active last 12m filter is fixed to true.

cards.name: KPI - Zero-review Listings
cards.description: Filtered listings with no reviews. One row per listing; includes new and inactive listings.

cards.name: Chart - Price vs Review Count
cards.description: Scatter of active, non-outlier listings: nightly price versus lifetime review count. One point per listing; not a time series.

cards.name: Chart - Listings by Room Type
cards.description: Filtered listings by room type. One row per listing; the chart collapses to one bar when the Room type filter is applied.

cards.name: Chart - Listings by Price Band
cards.description: Filtered listings by price band. One row per listing; the chart collapses to one bar when the Price band filter is applied.

cards.name: Chart - Review Count Distribution
cards.description: Distribution of lifetime review counts across filtered listings. One row per listing; helpful for spotting the long tail of highly reviewed listings.

cards.name: Chart - Active Listings by Host Segment
cards.description: Active filtered listings by host portfolio segment. One row per listing; this is listing-grain, not host-grain.

cards.name: Chart - Listings by Minimum Nights
cards.description: Filtered listings by minimum-night band. One row per listing; zero minimum nights are normalized to one upstream.

cards.name: Table - Listing Detail
cards.description: One row per listing with price, host, portfolio segment, activity, lifetime and 12-month reviews, sentiment, and recency for drill-down and verification.
cards.sql:
SELECT
    listing_id,
    listing_name,
    room_type,
    price,
    price_band,
    minimum_nights,
    host_name,
    host_segment,
    is_superhost,
    review_count,
    review_count_12m,
    avg_sentiment,
    pct_positive,
    last_review_date,
    is_active_last_12m,
    days_since_last_review
FROM analytics.mart_listing_performance
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{room_type}}
  AND {{price_band}}
  AND {{minimum_nights_band}}
  AND {{is_superhost}}
  AND {{host_segment}}
  AND {{is_active_last_12m}}
  AND {{price}}
ORDER BY review_count DESC
LIMIT 200;
